deterministic_rules.rule: seed map width must equal 32 and height must equal 32
every ground legend asset and object asset_id must exist in rookguard.asset-register.json
seed map must define exactly one spawn coordinate
seed map must define exactly one tutorial_gate coordinate and exactly one object with role tutorial_gate
spawn must reach tutorial_gate through non-blocked training-review tiles
exactly one first_instruction_sign object must be within Manhattan distance 5 of spawn
blocking objects must not seal the spawn-to-gate path
each water-edge tile must have at least one neighboring land/path tile and at least one edge or off-map neighbor
bundle source_ref must be original_akalynth_training_build_v1 and must not claim external map derivation
bundle text must not contain forbidden external game/place/NPC names
training seed map must not be imported into packages/shared/maps or server runtime world state
